Monthly Tweet Summary

TL;DR

This month, Ikizulive took on a major challenge by holding a simultaneous Christmas live performance across three locations: Tokyo, Osaka, and Fukui! Utilizing Mai's technical skills to bridge the distance, the members were also shocked and inspired by a surprise encounter with the group 'A-rise' in Akihabara.

Monthly Highlights

December became a memorable month for Ikizulive, as they overcame physical distance with passion and technology. Although they almost gave up on the Christmas event due to budget and schedule issues, they successfully held it thanks to Mai's innovative idea of a '3-location simultaneous live broadcast using monitors.' Each member performed at their respective location, yet their hearts were perfectly synchronized. Additionally, the encounter with a rising group named 'A-rise' in Akihabara made their identity and goals as school idols even clearer.

3-Location Simultaneous Christmas Live

They connected three venues—Akihabara (Tokyo), Umekita (Osaka), and a Farmers Market (Fukui)—online to perform live at the same time. By using rental monitors arranged by Mai and a large monitor brought from home by Aurora, they successfully created a performance where it felt like members from distant locations were standing on the same stage.
